text: Hello, this is the fraud department at SecureBank. We have detected suspicious activity on your account.
Oh really? What kind of suspicious activity?
Your account has been compromised. We need to verify your identity immediately. You must act within the next 10 minutes or your account will be suspended.
That sounds serious. What do I need to do?
Please provide your one-time password that was just sent to your phone. Do not hang up and do not tell anyone about this call. This is a confidential security procedure.
I see, I did get an OTP. Should I read it to you?
Yes, please provide the code immediately. Every second counts. If you delay, the fraudsters will empty your account.
